verdict.rationale: three.js is a JavaScript 3D rendering library, not an agent or application that invokes tools, so acting as an MCP client is outside its product category. The evidence shows only rendering, TSL and docs/llms.txt material, and nothing showing the library consumes MCP servers. The runtime probe notes that coding agents drive the library directly through npm, which places three.js on the tool side rather than the client side.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
